text:
Maya R: :wave: Quick sync — starting onboarding for new region "bhr-1" (Bahrain). Targeting pilot traffic Wednesday 2026-03-25. Need final owners for routing, KMS, and data-residency signoff. /cc @Sam H @Devon C @Jia L
Sam H: I'll own routing policies. I opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/488 — needs review from @Devon C for infra vars.
Devon C: infra ok for instance sizing and subnets. KMS key request pending — filing IT ticket now. ETA for key: ~48 hours.
Jia L: Security: confirm no cross-region backups enabled by default. We need explicit opt-in for backups and S3 replication. Also need PII scoping doc.
Maya R: noted. PII doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/regions/bhr-1/pii-scope.md (draft). Will update by EOD.
Sam H: Routing snippet for the canary policy — can someone eyeball?
```yaml
route:
  priority: regional
  prefer: bhr-1
  fallback: global-read
  ttl: 30s
```
Maya R: That looks fine; add health-check header check. @Devon C — are there any DB replica concerns for low-latency reads in bhr-1?
Devon C: We can add read replica in bhr-1 but cross-region write latency for leader will be higher. Proposal: regional reads + write-through to primary in eu-west-2, add cache layer. Need review from DB eng.
Aisha: echoing Devon — DB eng can set up async replica. Will open RFD and timeline.
Maya R: Milestones: owners locked by 2026-03-19, infra provision by 03-22, KMS & compliance signoff by 03-24, pilot 03-25. If any blockers, post here.
Sam H: pinging @Devon C and @Aisha for PR review. Also, lmk if we should run a small spike for TTL variations.
InfraBot: Provision job queued: job_id=proj-bhr-2026-03-18-02 — status: pending
Devon C: got the KMS ticket number TKT-7891. Sharing permissions doc now.
Jia L: I'll review PII doc tomorrow morning and confirm required controls. :ok_hand:
Maya R: thanks all — will follow up with calendar invite for handoff and a short roll call on Tuesday.
